thaumgiesis.crucible.guide: Left-click ingredients into the crucible. Right-click with a catalyst to craft.
thaumgiesis.crucible.dry: Right-click with a water bucket to fill the crucible.
thaumgiesis.crucible.heating: Heat the water from below until it boils.
thaumgiesis.crucible.no_recipe: No unlocked recipe matches this catalyst and the dissolved essentia.
thaumgiesis.crucible.book.title: Crucible recipes
thaumgiesis.crucible.book.locked: Complete research to reveal recipes here.
thaumgiesis.crucible.book.only_ready: Showing only recipes you can make now
thaumgiesis.crucible.book.none_ready: The crucible lacks the essentia for any recipe yet.
thaumgiesis.research.need_tools: Put scribing tools on the inkwell at the top left.
thaumgiesis.research.need_note: Put a research note in the middle of the table.
thaumgiesis.research.complete: Research complete! Put the quill down and right-click the note to take it.
thaumgiesis.research.no_ink: Out of ink: put fresh scribing tools on the table.
thaumgiesis.research.not_a_note: That is not a research note.
thaumgiesis.research.no_combination: Those aspects do not combine, or you have too few.
thaumgiesis.research.pick_pen: Left-click the inkwell to take up the quill.
thaumgiesis.research.dip: Click an aspect on the right to dip the quill, or drop aspects in the mixing dishes on the left.
thaumgiesis.research.write: Click an empty hex of the note to write the aspect, right-click to rub it out; click the inkwell to put the quill down.
thaumgiesis.research.empty_aspect: You have none of that aspect left.
thaumgiesis.research.tip.pen_take: Left-click to take up the quill, right-click to take the scribing tools
thaumgiesis.research.tip.pen_return: Left-click to put the quill down
thaumgiesis.research.tip.note_take: Right-click to take the note (quill down first)
thaumgiesis.research.tip.dish: Mixing dish: drop in two aspects to combine them, right-click to empty
